verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack covers bank-hosted OAuth connections, OAuth coverage across institutions, or retiring credential-based or screen-scraped flows. The only token evidence describes partner API authentication (Partner ID/secret/appKey), which is a different control. The 'link via Connect' mention does not specify the authentication method.

support.subject: As a developer, connections to major institutions use bank-hosted OAuth rather than screen-scraped credentials — the platform documents its OAuth coverage and how legacy credential flows are being retired
